formulas.name: forT_InProgressMessage
formulas.expression: 'I have taken ownership of your case and I have begun working on a solution. ' & IF(TEXT({!Get_Case_Details.Reason})='Issue', 'I will be in touch shortly to update you on my progress.', 'I will update you when I have progress to show you.') & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), ' In the meantime if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the meantime if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_MovedToBacklog
formulas.expression: 'I have reviewed your case and have moved it to Backlog for prioritization and grooming. ' & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), 'In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', 'In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_MovedToGrooming
formulas.expression: 'I have reviewed your case and moved it to Grooming for additional requirements gathering. ' & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), 'In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', 'In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_MovedToOnHold
formulas.expression: 'I have reviewed your case and have moved it to On Hold as there is additional information needed. Please provide ________. In addition, if you have questions please post them here in this case feed. ' & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), 'In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', 'In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_ReadyToTestMessage
formulas.expression: 'We are ready to have you test the solution for this case. Please login to the sandbox and complete your UAT tests. Once completed, reply to this notification with your feedback.' & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), ' In the meantime if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the meantime if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_SecondResponseMessage
formulas.expression: ' We continue to work on a solution for this case. The current status is _______. I expect to update you again by ______.' & IF(({!forB_CommunityUser}), ' In the meantime if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the meantime if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: forT_SolutionDeliveredMessage
formulas.expression: 'We have completed a solution for this case. Please test the solution and confirm we have met the requirements. If we have not received feedback on this solution within the next two weeks, we will assume this solution meets your needs and move this case to Closed.'
